items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: We would bring in Ronnie Cuber, great baritone player, David Sanborn played alto.

ctx.x: Yep. When I, yeah. The musicians union’s been great, AFM has been phenomenal. When I was out with Tower of Power — I did shows on like NBC when it was Late Night when it was at Rockefeller Center, before he moved to CBS. And me and Bruce Kapler, the saxophone player who was like a twenty year member of the CBS orchestra, me and him
would be the horn players on Late Night whenever they needed horn players. We would bring in Ronnie Cuber, great baritone player, David Sanborn played alto.
They couldn’t find anybody good, yeah, yeah, yeah.
